data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Potomac Capital Management's most recent 13F, for the period June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO, PESI, and CDZI.

On October 13, 2026, an Arapahoe County Board of County Commissioners meeting agenda item mentioned Sky Ranch (approval) (https://arapahoe.legistar.com/MeetingDetail.aspx?LEGID=3038&GID=826&G=9CD90149-B010-432C-9FC8-7BF802574B0E).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
